about: What a town's, township's or county's own records must hold before its seats run on a question (the lead, Nov 12: a council candidate in a town of a few hundred campaigning on civilian oversight of the police; contest-positions.ts `contestPositions`). Each question names the line of the local government's latest budget it is about: `spending`, a line it spends on (a town with no police spending has no police department to oversee or to send to federal immigration enforcement), or `revenue`, a line it takes in (a town with no sales tax of its own takes none off groceries). A local question not listed here needs no record beyond the state's law letting the place act on it. TUNABLE by question, checked against what a local government must run before it can act on the question.
